siteDescription: {appName} is a free Islamic app with no ads: track your Salah, make up Qaza, keep daily Zikr, read and practise the Qur'an, and learn your deen, on phone, web, watch and TV.

homeFeatures.salah: Salah tracker with streaks, calendar and statistics
homeFeatures.qaza: Qaza (missed Salah) calculator, daily-pace planner and missed-fast tracking
homeFeatures.zikr: Zikr tracker with guided adhkar sessions, source hadith and a tasbeeh counter
homeFeatures.quran: Offline Qur'an with word-by-word, tajweed colours, translations, tafsir and audio
homeFeatures.practice: On-device AI Qur'an recitation practice with spaced revision
homeFeatures.learn: Learn the Qur'an: Arabic letters, reading and tajweed lessons
homeFeatures.times: Salah times, Adhan and Qibla compass
homeFeatures.devices: Widgets, Live Activities, Apple Watch, Wear OS, Apple TV and Android TV
